gloss: delivery of a car (to its buyer)

definitions.gloss: delivery of a car (to its buyer)
definitions.explanation: Handing over a newly bought vehicle to the customer, said both of the dealer delivering it and of the buyer receiving it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{納車|のうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧です。
examples.english: The new car will be delivered next month.

examples.japanese: {納車|のうしゃ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told delivery would take three months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{納車|のうしゃ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The dealer agreed to deliver the car to my house on the weekend.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {納車|のうしゃ}{日|び}: delivery day
- {納車|のうしゃ}{待|ま}ち: waiting for one's car to be delivered
- {納車|のうしゃ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a car delivered

USAGE:
- Used of cars, motorbikes and other vehicles. Delivering other goods to a customer is ⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧.
